runs.t: Which description best captures the main purpose of

options.text: Distributed business workflows often span independent services that cannot share one ACID transaction.
ACID describes atomicity, consistency, isolation and durability of database transactions.
BASE describes a family of distributed-system trade-offs often summarized as Basically Available, Soft state and Eventual consistency.
Timeouts bound waiting, retries recover transient failures, and backoff spaces repeated attempts to avoid overload.

runs.t: Which implementation approach most directly applies

options.text: Study quorums, leader election, replicated logs, safety versus liveness, and fault models.
Use asynchronous replication, derived views and reconciliation rules to keep serving useful operations.
Distinguish stale reads, concurrent conflicting writes, causal ordering and convergence policy.
Under partition, a consistency-oriented system may reject or delay operations to avoid contradictory answers; an availability-oriented system may accept operations that reconcile later.

runs.t: A product-rating average may lag new reviews briefly while the review itself is persisted durably.
What is the most appropriate response?

options.text: A webhook delivery retries 503 responses with jitter for a bounded period, but a malformed 400 request goes to a dead-letter workflow instead of looping indefinitely.
Reusing its idempotency key must return the original outcome, not issue a second charge, even if the first response was lost.
A moderation status must still prevent disallowed content from being published.
If the write fails, neither partial operation should become visible as successful.

runs.t: , which trade-off or common mistake deserves particular attention?

options.text: 'Last write wins' can silently discard legitimate updates.

Exactly-once effects across arbitrary components are difficult; most systems build at-least-once delivery plus idempotent processing.
Eventual consistency without a bounded user expectation can look like data loss.

runs.t: An AI agent works on this task:

Which proposed verification task most directly tests the required behavior?

options.text: Ask an agent to model asynchronously updated review averages with retry and reconciliation. Define how the UI indicates pending updates and how correctness is checked.
Have an agent simulate delayed replica propagation for profile edits. Define conflict resolution, read-after-write expectations and tests ensuring convergence after messages arrive.
Ask an agent to implement an idempotent payment endpoint with persistence-backed keys. Test duplicate requests, concurrent races, different payloads and process restart.
Have an agent implement an order-credit transaction with invariant tests, forced rollback, and concurrent withdrawals. Document the actual configured isolation level.

runs.t: Який компроміс або типову помилку особливо важливо врахувати під час застосування

options.text: «Останній запис перемагає» може непомітно втратити коректне оновлення.
ACID не гарантує коректність ваших бізнес-правил чи атомарність зовнішнього email/платіжного API.
Exactly-once ефект між довільними компонентами складний; зазвичай поєднують at-least-once доставку та ідемпотентну обробку.
